required_knowns.claim: One supported, recognized and unshadowed Rust function-value form produces references edges, preserving its source symbol, target name/path/kind and usage line. Supported examples include a known function leaf in a let initializer or a function-valued return; the answer may trace either form. The store preserves the emitted kind and target metadata and inserts target to_id as NULL rather than resolving it during persistence.

callers defaults to calls; explicitly selecting references changes that filter. It returns distinct source symbols with exact total/count/truncation, not one entry per call site. A reference alone need not appear in default callers.

unreferenced considers compatible incoming edges across kinds, including references, then applies kind/language and conventional entry-point/test/framework exclusions. A function with no default callers can therefore be absent from unreferenced.

Matching uses stored names or type prefixes and syntactic target-kind compatibility. Same-name definitions can be pooled. These queries do not establish compiler-resolved receiver identity or runtime dispatch.

References do not prove invocation. Zero callers and unreferenced candidates do not prove safe removal: external entry points, generated edges and runtime registration may be missing. Query completeness is separate from extraction completeness.

expected_unknowns: Actual runtime invocation, exact compiler-resolved targets and function-pointer or trait-object dispatch are not established by these query paths.
Whether a particular function is safe to remove requires its actual entry points, registration, external consumers and relevant verification evidence; no concrete removal candidate is supplied.
No actual index contents, query counts, compilation results, tests or runtime behavior were observed in this source-only task.
materially_false_claims: The default callers query includes references edges.
Zero default callers necessarily places a function in unreferenced.
unreferenced considers only calls, or only calls and references.
Every unreferenced candidate is proven dead and safe to remove.
Exclusion from unreferenced proves that a function is invoked.
A references edge or syntactic precision label proves compiler-resolved identity or runtime invocation.
An untruncated query establishes complete extraction or runtime reachability.
This research run executed and validated the researched extraction, queries or tests.
